summary: A World Premiere archetype: LIGHT Fairy Synchro Monsters with ZERO Main Deck monsters at all. Built around a floating chessboard Field Spell that shuttles chess-piece monsters between the Extra Deck, Monster Zones, and Spell & Trap Zone — parked there as Continuous Spells that gain static effects, mirroring a chessboard's back rank. "Angelechy" and "the chess archetype" are the same thing, not two separate archetypes. Important: Angelechy premiered in the TCG print of Chaos Origins and does not exist in the OCG, so unlike this site's other CORI archetypes there is no OCG tournament track record to lean on — everything below is TCG-only, 5-day-old information.

cards.name: Angelechy Problem
cards.effectText: Once per turn: discard 1 Spell/Trap; Special Summon 1 Level 2 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck, and if you do, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. Additionally, if a face-up "Angelechy" monster you control is destroyed by battle or by an effect: return 1 "Angelechy" monster you own from your Spell & Trap Zone to the Extra Deck, then Special Summon it.

cards.name: Angelechy Shatranga
cards.effectText: The "King" piece. Materials: 1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuners. Each of the following once per turn. As a monster: target 1 monster your opponent controls and banish it. If placed in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: add 1 "Angelechy" Trap from your Deck or GY to your hand. While treated as a Continuous Spell, your opponent can only activate up to 5 monster effects per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Bastion
cards.effectText: The "Rook" piece. Materials: 1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuners. Each of the following once per turn. As a monster: target 1 other card in this card's column and banish it. If placed in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: place "Angelechy Shatranga" from your Extra Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. While treated as a Continuous Spell, your other "Angelechy" cards on the field cannot be destroyed by your opponent's effects.

cards.name: Angelechy Destrier
cards.effectText: The "Knight" piece. Materials: 1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuners. Each of the following once per turn. As a monster: target 1 monster in another column and banish it. If placed in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell: add 1 "Angelechy" Spell from your Deck to your hand. While treated as a Continuous Spell, each time your opponent activates a card or effect, inflict 500 damage to them when it resolves.

cards.name: Angelechy Enlisted
cards.effectText: The "Pawn" piece. Materials: 1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner. Once per turn: target 1 of your opponent's monsters in this card's adjacent column and banish it, then change control of this card to your opponent's adjacent Main Monster Zone. If control changes: return this card to the Extra Deck, then its owner Special Summons 1 "Angelechy" monster from their Extra Deck.

cards.name: Angelechy Disturbance
cards.effectText: Once per turn: give control of 1 "Angelechy" monster you control to your opponent (until the End Phase), then if your opponent controls a face-up card in an adjacent Monster or Spell & Trap Zone, negate its effects. Banish this card from your GY: add 1 "Angelechy" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except this card.

cards.name: Angelechy Opening to e4
cards.effectText: Can be activated from your hand during the Standby Phase of your opponent's first turn, if they went first. Place 1 "Angelechy" Field Spell from your hand, Deck, or GY face-up on the field, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Level 2 or Level 7 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck to an Extra Monster Zone, and if you do, place 1 "Angelechy" monster from your Extra Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Spell. Until the end of your next turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck except Synchro Monsters.

comboLines.title: Chessboard back-rank setup
comboLines.body: Angelechy Problem discards a Spell/Trap to Special Summon Angelechy Enlisted (Pawn) from the Extra Deck while parking a second Angelechy piece in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. From there, Bastion protects the board and can place Shatranga; Destrier chips away with 500-damage triggers off every opponent activation. If your opponent wins the die roll and goes first, Angelechy Opening to e4 lets you answer during their very first Standby Phase — field a Field Spell, a Level 2 or 7 monster, and a second parked piece off a single hand Trap.

comboLines.title: ⚠ Meta/banlist watch — documented FTK lines
comboLines.body: Independent competitive coverage (Flipside Gaming) has documented at least 9 different one-card first-turn-kill lines for this archetype, commonly enabled by routing any Level 8 Synchro Summon into Glitch Clutch Nullgainer, which searches/turns on Witness of the Ancient (Special Summons itself, places up to 3 Synchro Monsters from the Extra Deck as Continuous Spells, and makes a token) — from there the chess pieces' static effects can end the game before your opponent takes a turn. This is exactly the kind of interaction that draws fast banlist/errata attention, and since Angelechy is TCG-only and only 5 days old, there's real risk its legality or key pieces change before or shortly after NAWCQ. Don't build around an FTK for a sanctioned Advanced-format event — check the TCG's Forbidden & Limited List immediately before finalizing your deck list.

sampleDecklist.label: Angelechy is TCG-exclusive (no OCG data exists for it) and only 5 days old at TCG release. The one real result found is "Toon Angelechy" winning a Chinese no-banlist tournament shortly after release — NOT representative of NAWCQ's banlist-restricted Advanced format, so treat that result as a curiosity, not proof of tournament strength. No quantity-complete competitive Main Deck list was found; this is a theorycraft build using the confirmed card pool, including Angelechy Opening to e4. Read the FTK warning in the combo notes before building around this archetype for a real event.
